goal: AR fallback and device capability checks in frontend/src/components/ and frontend/src/lib/imperial/.
summary: Implemented WebXR AR capabilities detection, graceful user camera consent handling, mobile performance budget analysis, and interactive 2D turntable/rubbing fallback in frontend/src/lib/imperial/ar-capabilities.ts and frontend/src/components/imperial/ar/ (ARCapabilityGate, RelicTurntableInspector). Added backend relic inspection persistence service and endpoints (POST /api/v1/imperial/inspections/complete and GET /api/v1/imperial/inspections/{target_slug}) backed by additive migration 0065_imperial_relic_inspections. Strictly enforced the crucial Negative Abuse Invariant: denying camera permission or using 2D turntable fallback NEVER penalizes the learner; it completes the 100% equivalent learning task with identical server-verified completion status, full XP (+25 XP), and motif progression advancement. Verified with 10 passing integration tests in tests/v5/test_v5_t045.py, 17 Vitest tests in frontend, clean TypeScript type-check, ESLint, and OpenAPI snapshot / route inventory parity.

invariants_enforced.equivalent_learning_task_invariant: Denying camera permission or using 2D turntable fallback MUST allow the learner to complete the 100% equivalent learning/inspection task. Learners are never blocked, penalized, or degraded, and receive the identical 25 XP reward and progression credit as an AR user.
invariants_enforced.graceful_camera_consent_lifecycle: Camera permissions are queried respectfully. If permissions are prompt, a non-intrusive modal explains the educational purpose with an explicit privacy pledge and clear dual-choice options (AR vs Turntable 360°/2D).
invariants_enforced.mobile_performance_budget_guard: Devices with < 3GB RAM, saveData enabled, slow connections (2G/3G), or low GPU capability are automatically routed to lightweight 2D turntable/rubbing inspection without crashing or excessive battery drain.
invariants_enforced.anti_replay_and_idempotency: Submitting duplicate inspection sessions on the same relic or with an existing idempotency key returns already_completed=True with 0 duplicate XP, preventing progression inflation.
invariants_enforced.quality_gate_scrutiny: Superficial clicks are rejected by the server: inspection duration < 3 seconds returns HTTP 400 (INSUFFICIENT_INSUFFICIENT_INSPECTION_TIME), and zero angles/hotspots viewed returns HTTP 400 (INCOMPLETE_INSPECTION_TASK).
invariants_enforced.guest_access_guard: Guest users can only inspect demo relics; inspecting non-demo relics is rejected with HTTP 403 (FORBIDDEN_GUEST_ACCESS).
invariants_enforced.motif_progression_sync: Completing a relic inspection task on a relief motif automatically advances user progress from hidden to discovered in the user_progress table.

changes.description: Created AR capability detection, camera consent requesting, mobile performance budgeting, and equivalent learning session management engine.
Added 17 Vitest unit tests covering WebXR detection, camera permission flows, mobile budgets, mode resolution, and the negative abuse equivalence invariant.
Added ImperialInspectionCompleteRequest, ImperialInspectionCompleteResponse, and ImperialInspectionStatusResponse interfaces.
Implemented completeRelicInspection and fetchRelicInspectionStatus client functions with offline/dev resilience.
Created graceful AR capability gate and permission modal offering seamless dual-path choice and non-punishing camera denial banner.
Created interactive 360° turntable and 2D rubbing inspection component with drag/touch rotation, angle presets, zoom, hotspot overlay, and task completion submission.
Created Pydantic request and response schemas for relic inspection task completion.
Added ImperialRelicInspection SQLAlchemy model for persistent inspection records.
Imported and registered ImperialRelicInspection with Base.metadata.
Added additive Alembic migration creating imperial_relic_inspections table with unique and performance indices.
Implemented server domain service handling target resolution, anti-abuse duration/interaction quality gates, anti-replay idempotency, and equivalent learning completion.
Created comprehensive 10-test integration test suite covering happy path, negative camera denial equivalence, anti-replay, quality gates, RBAC, and motif progression synchronization.
